regions.name: Borneo
regions.quote: Betta ocellata is a large paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from Sabah, northeastern Borneo, and the Sebuku River basin in East Kalimantan.

regions.name: Kinabatangan
regions.quote: In the Kinabatangan drainage basin B. ocellata was collected from ox-bow lakes and lowland streams with turbid water.
